query:
INSERT INTO assets (
                            id, name, path, state, format_type, family, file_size, 
                            created_at, modified_at, added_at, updated_at, folder_id
                        )
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                        ON CONFLICT(path) DO UPDATE SET
                            updated_at = excluded.updated_at
                        RETURNING id as "id!"
